name: genai-eval
description: Qualify a GenAI evaluation as a measurement instrument. Ships eval-qualify: judge-human agreement with bootstrap confidence intervals read against the human-human ceiling, judge bias probes for length, position, self-preference and prompt sensitivity, a power check against a stated minimum detectable effect, and an observed disagreement taxonomy — all on a stdlib-only statistics toolkit. Runs standalone on a CSV of judge scores and human labels. eval-design and the machine-readable eval card are planned, not yet built.
